schema.behavior: Existing executor records migrate with empty discovery choices; older clients refuse the newer schema.

changes: Per-Server registered executor persists explicitly named discovery roots and optional Pi release root/Node pair.
Public configure-discovery and scoped discover CLI commands persist, preview and clear the configuration.
Automatic daemon composes passive discovery through the public Core facade and preserves full candidates.
Physical path identity is checked before and after discovery; configuration changes invalidate the control snapshot.
Pi may use a named Node file outside the release root, without trusting the parent directory.
No runtime, workspace binding or lease authority is granted by discovery.

retained_attempts.finding: Test helper import used the wrong namespace. Corrected to the existing tests.unit import convention.
189 tests passed before the explicit external Node trust case was added; final rebuilt wheel passes 190.

limitations: The CLI subprocess journey seeds an already registered executor locally; network registration and full public onboarding are not accepted by this evidence.
The real-file discovery tests use harmless copied interpreter files and a synthetic Pi package layout; no actual provider is launched.
Launch configuration, realization publication/acknowledgement and reusable binding CLI flows remain to integrate for real remote provider journeys.
Nexus product and Core code are unchanged. Prior real local provider results remain tied to Core 0.2.42.
Full M03/M10 and M08 acceptance and G0-G3 remain open.
